title: KillForHead
description: A data pack that adds head-dropping to the game
body:
The data pack adds to your game the ability to knock out the head of another player when he is killed, showing your superiority over him or starting a bounty hunt.
- The player's head falls out only once per game.
- The head only drops when a player kills a player
- The data pack is fully functional on all versions starting from 1.21

The data pack was written specifically for the GHOST.TEAM server.

CREATED WITH THE SUPPORT OF ANONYMOUS SPONSORS
